hullmodId: # Hullmods that deal damage by themselves
kind: scored as a weapon without a mount (0.5.40). Read by JAOShip when the hullmod is on the ship.

hullmodId: # kind: timed (attacks at its own rate) or onHits (fires at targets the ship's non-beam weapons just hit).
# rate (attacks a second) and damage: one value or four split by ; (frigate;destroyer;cruiser;capital). empPerDamage: EMP per point of damage.
# pd: TRUE when it also hits missiles and fighters. smodRateMult: rate multiplier when s-modded.

rate: minWeight and maxWeight (weight of recent hits
damage: one per hit in the last window seconds)

hullmodId: # 0.5.99: a row keyed by a ship system or defense id is a system that deals damage; it counts on hulls with that system

note: Shrouded Lens: a 75 energy explosion (radius 50) on a random ship or missile within 400; 1/2/3/4 a second by hull size and x1.5 s-modded; 75 flux each

Shrouded Thunderhead: Rift Lightning at a target a non-beam weapon hit in the last 0.1 s; one try every 0.22-0.44 s against a misfire weight of 100; 200/300/400/500 energy and twice that EMP by hull size; 1 flux per damage

Abyssal Entropy Projector: every 10 s, 2/2/3/4 EMP arcs by hull size at the nearest enemy ship within 1000 (not fighters, drones, phased or Abyssal ships); 300 energy and 400 EMP each; spawnEmpArc, so shields block; no flux cost. On Abyssal hulls 20% chance per arc to chain to a second ship (rate x1.2 there). no_build_in, so no s-mod rate.

Adaptive Entropy Projector (hidden): the id the Abyssal projector swaps itself to on non-Abyssal hulls, so this is the id on the variant there. Same arcs: 2/2/3/4 per 10 s, 300 energy and 400 EMP each, nearest enemy ship within 1000, shields block, no chain, no flux cost.

Terraprisma: 8 blades, each starts a pass at an enemy within 800 every 12-15 s (13.5 mean) and explodes 600 energy (minimum 300) on each enemy it crosses; 8 / 13.5 = 0.59 passes a second x 0.8 for fly-in and missed passes (judgment) = 0.47; no flux cost; blades take no damage

Grand Salvo (ship system edshipyard_grand_salvo since 0.5.99; Beagle with 1 Hellborn gun, Dobermann with 4): GrandSalvoStats ACTIVE spawns one edshipyard_BIGGUN projectile (75 HE, proximity fuse radius 50, speed 500, range 1600) per gun every 0.05 s / ballistic rate of fire for 8 s with a +-10 degree spread; in 2, out 2, cooldown 40 (52 s cycle) = 160 shells per gun per use, 3.08 a second per gun. Rate = 3.08 x guns x AI 0.85 x 0.4 landing (judgment: +-10 degrees at 1000 to 1600 su against 150 to 300 su wide targets) = 1.05 (Beagle), 4.19 (Dobermann). No flux cost: spawnProjectile charges none. Row sits on edshipyard_module_range because only these two hulls and the module carry it

Detonator drones (Beauceron Mk.II 1 module, Retriever Mk.II 2): each control module launches 1 drone (maxDrones 1, regen 0.015 a second) = 2.35 drones in a 90 s fight, 0.0261 a second a module; SelfDestructStats ACTIVE explodes it for 2500 HE at the core (200 su) falling to 500 at 400 su, friendly fire on. Rate x 0.6 reaching the target (judgment: 800 hull points, armor 900, 7 s charge-up) = 0.0157 a module; the drone's roam range is 2500

Broken Wings (Nanz, Voyager; needs the Stardust swarm): NA_BrokenWings fires an arc from a stardust mote at a random enemy every 0.15-0.3 s while in, active and out (9 of a 19 s cycle), about 37 arcs a use; damage and EMP 200 + 75 x flux level (240 at half flux, judgment), high explosive; 37 / 19 s x 0.85 AI use = 1.65 a second; reach 300/425/575/700 by size (500 judgment)

Volatile Vents (Karma, Samsara): while venting an energy arc every 0.08-0.12 s from a system slot at a random ship, asteroid or missile within 400/500/600/700 (allies included), 10/20/40/80 damage and twice that EMP; 10 arcs a second x 0.12 of the fight venting x 0.4 landing on an enemy (judgment) = 0.5; range 600 is the cruiser value

Volatile Dissipation (Rigveda): above 75% flux an energy arc every 0.08-0.14 s at a random entity within 350/400/450/500, damage 10/20/40/80 x hard flux level and twice that EMP; 9 arcs a second x 0.15 of the fight above 75% flux x 0.4 landing on an enemy (judgment) = 0.55; damage at hard flux 0.5; range 400 is the destroyer value

Dweller Entropy Projector: every 7 s (Maelstrom 3.5 s) 2/2/3/4 arcs by hull size at the nearest enemy ship within 2000 (Maelstrom 2200), 300 energy and 400 EMP each, shields block; Dwellers chain a second arc at 100%: pulses / 7 x 1.7 (second target about 70% of the time, judgment); the Maelstrom's double rate is not in the row
AURA missiles (system): 120 energy, range 1200; 2 or 4 SYSTEM slots x 7.5 a use x 5.5 uses in 90 s.
AURA Unit missiles (system): 1 or 2 SYSTEM slots x 6.4 a use x 4.8 uses.
Adaptive Burst Formia shots (system): 65 energy and 200 EMP, 12 a use at half flux x 5.7 uses.
EMP Emission (system, Phobia Jorogumo): 640 damage and 3600 EMP a use, 800 flux. About 10 uses in 90 s (judgment).
